content: इ The third letter of the Devanāgarī alphabet.

इः [अ-इञ्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Kāmadeva; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ki. 15. 45</ls>. .²2 the number 100; <ls>Gīrvāṇa.</ls> {%ind.%} An interjection of (1) anger; (2) calling; (3) compassion; (4) reproach; (5) wonder; (6) sorrow; (7) distress. <ab>cf.</ab> इः कामः स्थाणुरिन्द्रोऽर्को वरुणः पादपो द्विपः . शुचिः श्रीमानजो बालो विरिञ्चिः कृत्तिकासुतः .. <ls>Enm.</ls>

इ I. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (In Dhātup. written as इण्) (एति, इयाय, अगात्, एतुम्, इत) .²1 To go, go to or towards, come to or near; शशिनं पुनरेति शर्वरी <ls>R. 8. 56</ls>; ईयुर्भरद्वाजमुनेर्निकेतम् <ls>Bk. 3. 40</ls>. .²2 To arrive at, reach, obtain, attain to, go to or be reduced to a particular state, fall into; निर्बुद्धिः क्षयमेति <ls>Mk. 1. 14</ls> goes to (ruin, is ruined; so वशम्, शत्रुत्वम्, शूद्रताम् <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 To return. .²4 To go away, retire; elapse, pass. .²5 To spring from, come or arise from. .²6 To undertake anything (with <ab>acc.</ab>); सत्रमायन् <ls>Vāj.</ls> .²7 To ask, beg. .²8 To be; to appear. .²9 To be employed in, go on with, be in a particular condition or relation, with a <ab>part.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab>; कृषन्तो ह स्म वै वपन्तो यन्ति <ls>Śat. Br.</ls>; गवामयनेनेयुः <ls>Kāty.</ls> .²10 To thrive, prosper. --II. €1 <ab>U.</ab> = अय् <ab>q. v.</ab> --III. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> .²1 To come, appear. .²2 To run, wander. .²3 To go quickly or repeatedly. .²4 To ask, request. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to go or come.
